preview: Guyana Amazon Warriors face Saint Lucia Kings in CPL 2026 Match 31 at Providence Stadium. The match is scheduled for Wed 9 Sep at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Guyana retain Shimron Hetmyer, Romario Shepherd, Shai Hope and Shamar Joseph, while 10 of their 12 locally selected players come from Guyana. Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
